item.title: Cognitive behaviour therapy may outperform bright light therapy for insomnia in breast cancer patients on chemotherapy
item.description: 1. Cognitive behaviour therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) appears more effective than bright light therapy in reducing insomnia among women receiving chemotherapy for breast cancer.

item.title: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak exceeds 5,700 cases with no validated vaccine available
item.description: 1. The 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has reached 5,794 confirmed cases and 2,786 deaths, while the only licensed Ebola vaccine has uncertain effectiveness.

item.title: Early mitochondrial stress may explain lasting heart protection mechanism
item.description: Mitochondria are often called the cell's powerhouse, but they also serve as signaling hubs. Some stress early on may trigger protective effects in the heart.

item.title: When to worry about numbness and tingling: Expert explains neuropathy and other causes
item.description: Most people occasionally experience numbness or a pins-and-needles sensation, which is often temporary and harmless. However, persistent symptoms may indicate an underlying issue.
